title: STRANGE MINUTE #15 · WHAT IF
endSub: How many cans have YOU had today?

lines.text: What if you drank only energy drinks for a week?
Four big cans a day. Nothing else.
One big can can pack about 160 milligrams of caffeine.
lines.say: One big can can pack about a hundred sixty milligrams of caffeine.

lines.text: Four of them is 640. Way past the 400 most adults handle safely.
lines.say: Four of them is six hundred forty. Way past the four hundred most adults handle safely.

lines.text: A Mayo Clinic study found one can raised blood pressure.
Each can holds around 50 grams of sugar.
lines.say: Each can holds around fifty grams of sugar.

lines.text: That's 200 a day. Four times the WHO limit.
lines.say: That's two hundred a day. Four times the W H O limit.

lines.text: Sleep falls apart. You crash, and grab another can.
The acid slowly wears down your tooth enamel.
No protein. No vegetables. Your body runs on empty.
By day seven, you'd feel more tired than when you started.
So, how many cans have YOU had today?
lines.say: So, how many cans have you had today?
